posts.text: Researchers found evidence of life buried in rock layers that date to around 3.497 billion years ago, during the Paleoarchean Eon. The carbonaceous matter is among the earliest known occurrences of biologically generated organic matter. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/lwtl50ZBWHo

Scientists report evidence of about 16 cascading floods that wreaked havoc across Europe between late 1341 and 1343—the largest number of back-to-back flooding events documented in the past 700 years.

Learn more: https://scim.ag/4wze45N

posts.text: Breathing a mix of carbon tetrafluoride and oxygen for 10 minutes before decompression from a simulated 200-foot dive reduced decompression sickness in pigs. The technique could extend the depth accessible for human exploration. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/SFsl50ZB3zr

Fast-growing wildfires tend to be stronger and burn a larger proportion of area at high severity levels, according to a new analysis of 3499 recent wildfires in the conifer forests of Canada and the western United States.
